uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user (max 1000 chars).

createdAt.description: When the user profile was created.

RosterClass.title: RosterClass
RosterClass.description: A class notebook saved to the teacher's active roster.

classId.description: The Microsoft Graph ID of the class or notebook (max 1000 chars).

displayName.description: The name of the class (max 1000 chars).

description.description: The description of the class (max 1000 chars).

addedAt.description: When the class was added to the roster.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A parsed and potentially edited student journal entry.

entryId.description: A unique ID for this entry, typically combining pageId and an index (max 1000 chars).

pageId.description: The Microsoft Graph ID of the OneNote page (max 1000 chars).

classId.description: The ID of the class this entry belongs to (max 1000 chars).

studentName.description: The name of the student (max 1000 chars).

date.description: The date of the journal entry (max 1000 chars).

weekNumber.description: The week number of the journal entry (max 1000 chars).

weather.description: The weather recorded in the entry (max 1000 chars).

diaryTextOriginal.description: The original text written by the student (max 100000 chars).

diaryTextCorrected.description: The AI-corrected or teacher-edited text (max 100000 chars).

teacherFeedback.description: The feedback drafted by AI or written by the teacher (max 50000 chars).

translations.description: Translations included in the entry (max 50000 chars).

vocabCount.description: The number of vocabulary words used (-10000 to 10000).

sentiment.description: The sentiment of the entry (max 1000 chars).

topics.description: The topics covered in the entry (max 50000 chars).

status.description: The workflow status of this entry.

oneNoteLastModified.description: The last modified date of the page in OneNote.

approvedAt.description: When the teacher approved this entry.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last updated in Firestore.

vocabItems.description: The vocabulary items used in the entry (max 500000 chars).

photoCount.description: The number of photos in the entry (-1000000 to 1000000).

translationCount.description: The number of translations in the entry (-1000000 to 1000000).

chatbotFeedback.description: The chatbot feedback for the entry (max 500000 chars).

/users/{userId}/roster/{classId}.description: Stores the active roster of classes for a teacher.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores the parsed and edited journal entries for a teacher.
